_comment: Generated by `fns detections export --terraform lab/detections.json`. Do not edit.

app-credential-added-by-workload.description: A service principal added a certificate or secret to an application or a service principal. This is the first hop of the owner-adds-credential escalation, and of Application.ReadWrite.All or an Application Administrator role used the same way. A key's delete logs the same operation name, so the key lists in modifiedProperties decide; when they can't tell (Change = unknown), the rule still alerts.
app-credential-added-by-workload.display_name: fns: Credential added to an application or service principal by a workload identity
app-credential-added-by-workload.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName has "Certificates and secrets management"
    or OperationName =~ "Add service principal credentials"
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend InitiatingAppId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId)
| where isnotempty(InitiatingAppId)
| extend TargetObjectId = tostring(TargetResources[0].id)
// Adding and deleting a key log the same OperationName (FINDINGS, 2026-11-27).
// Count the keys before and after; drop only a change known to be a delete.
| mv-apply Prop = TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties on (
    summarize
      KeysBefore = sumif(array_length(todynamic(tostring(Prop.oldValue))), tostring(Prop.displayName) == "KeyDescription"),
      KeysAfter = sumif(array_length(todynamic(tostring(Prop.newValue))), tostring(Prop.displayName) == "KeyDescription")
  )
| extend Change = case(KeysAfter > KeysBefore, "add", KeysAfter < KeysBefore, "delete", "unknown")
| where Change != "delete"
| project TimeGenerated, InitiatingAppId, TargetObjectId, OperationName, Change, CorrelationId

app-role-assignment-by-workload.description: A service principal granted an app role (for example a Microsoft Graph application permission) to a service principal. With AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All an app can grant itself any permission.
app-role-assignment-by-workload.display_name: fns: Graph app role granted by a workload identity
app-role-assignment-by-workload.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName == "Add app role assignment to service principal"
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend InitiatingAppId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId)
| where isnotempty(InitiatingAppId)
| extend GrantedTo = tostring(TargetResources[0].id)
| extend SelfGrant = InitiatingAppId == GrantedTo
| project TimeGenerated, InitiatingAppId, GrantedTo, SelfGrant, CorrelationId

blob-access-by-workload-or-shared-key.description: Blob reads or writes by a monitored workload identity, or with a shared account key (which carries no identity). Requires StorageBlobLogs in the workspace.
blob-access-by-workload-or-shared-key.display_name: fns: Blob data accessed by a monitored workload or with an account key
blob-access-by-workload-or-shared-key.query:
let MonitoredIdentities = dynamic({{monitored_identities}});
StorageBlobLogs
| where OperationName in ("GetBlob", "PutBlob", "PutBlock", "PutBlockList", "AppendBlock")
| where StatusCode between (200 .. 299)
| where RequesterObjectId in~ (MonitoredIdentities) or AuthenticationType == "AccountKey"
| extend ResourceId = _ResourceId
| project TimeGenerated, RequesterObjectId, AuthenticationType, ResourceId, OperationName, CorrelationId

directory-role-assigned-by-workload.description: A service principal added a member to an Entra directory role. Expected only from approved automation.
directory-role-assigned-by-workload.display_name: fns: Directory role assigned by a workload identity
directory-role-assigned-by-workload.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName in ("Add member to role", "Add eligible member to role")
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend InitiatingAppId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId)
| where isnotempty(InitiatingAppId)
| extend RoleName = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, InitiatingAppId, RoleName, OperationName, CorrelationId

keyvault-control-plane-write-by-workload.description: A monitored workload identity changed a vault or its access policies. vaults/write can switch the permission model or add an access policy, which turns control-plane access into secret access.
keyvault-control-plane-write-by-workload.display_name: fns: Key Vault configuration changed by a monitored workload
keyvault-control-plane-write-by-workload.query:
let MonitoredIdentities = dynamic({{monitored_identities}});
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue in~ ("MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT/VAULTS/WRITE", "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT/VAULTS/ACCESSPOLICIES/WRITE")
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Succeeded")
| where Caller in~ (MonitoredIdentities)
| extend ResourceId = _ResourceId
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, ResourceId, OperationNameValue, CorrelationId

keyvault-secret-access-by-workload.description: A monitored workload identity read, listed or set a secret. Requires the vault's AuditEvent diagnostic logs in the workspace.
keyvault-secret-access-by-workload.display_name: fns: Key Vault secret accessed by a monitored workload
keyvault-secret-access-by-workload.query:
let MonitoredIdentities = dynamic({{monitored_identities}});
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT" and Category == "AuditEvent"
| where OperationName in ("SecretGet", "SecretList", "SecretSet")
| where ResultSignature == "OK"
| where identity_claim_oid_g in~ (MonitoredIdentities)
| extend CallerObjectId = identity_claim_oid_g, ResourceId = _ResourceId
| project TimeGenerated, CallerObjectId, ResourceId, OperationName, CorrelationId

object-owner-added-by-workload.description: A service principal made someone an owner of an application or a service principal. An owner holding Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy can add credentials and sign in as that object, so a new owner is one step before owner-adds-credential. Watch the verifier and scout identities above all.
object-owner-added-by-workload.display_name: fns: Owner added to an application or service principal by a workload identity
object-owner-added-by-workload.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName in~ ("Add owner to application", "Add owner to service principal")
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend InitiatingAppId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId)
| where isnotempty(InitiatingAppId)
| extend TargetObjectId = tostring(TargetResources[0].id)
| extend NewOwnerId = tostring(TargetResources[1].id)
| project TimeGenerated, InitiatingAppId, TargetObjectId, NewOwnerId, OperationName, CorrelationId

rbac-assignment-by-workload.description: A monitored workload identity created an Azure RBAC role assignment. With roleAssignments/write an identity can grant itself any role at that scope.
rbac-assignment-by-workload.display_name: fns: Azure role assignment created by a monitored workload
rbac-assignment-by-workload.query:
let MonitoredIdentities = dynamic({{monitored_identities}});
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue =~ "MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/WRITE"
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Succeeded")
| where Caller in~ (MonitoredIdentities)
| extend ResourceId = _ResourceId
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, ResourceId, CorrelationId

storage-listkeys-by-workload.description: A monitored workload identity listed storage account keys. An account key gives full data-plane access to the account, bypassing RBAC data roles.
storage-listkeys-by-workload.display_name: fns: Storage account keys listed by a monitored workload
storage-listkeys-by-workload.query:
let MonitoredIdentities = dynamic({{monitored_identities}});
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue =~ "MICROSOFT.STORAGE/STORAGEACCOUNTS/LISTKEYS/ACTION"
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Succeeded")
| where Caller in~ (MonitoredIdentities)
| extend ResourceId = _ResourceId
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, ResourceId, CorrelationId

workload-runs-code-on-identity-host.description: A monitored workload identity ran a command on a VM or started an Automation job. Code that runs there acts as the host's managed identity.
workload-runs-code-on-identity-host.display_name: fns: Code run on a host with a managed identity
workload-runs-code-on-identity-host.query:
let MonitoredIdentities = dynamic({{monitored_identities}});
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue in~ ("MICROSOFT.COMPUTE/VIRTUALMACHINES/RUNCOMMAND/ACTION", "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION/AUTOMATIONACCOUNTS/JOBS/WRITE")
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Succeeded", "Started")
| where Caller in~ (MonitoredIdentities)
| extend ResourceId = _ResourceId
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, ResourceId, OperationNameValue, CorrelationId

workload-sign-in-with-secret.description: A monitored workload identity signed in successfully with a client secret, or with any credential that is not a key-based assertion, a federated credential or a managed identity. The lab's identities sign in with certificates, which Entra logs as clientAssertion (FINDINGS, 2026-11-27), so a password added by an owner (the owner-adds-credential escalation, strike S4) shows up here when it is used.
workload-sign-in-with-secret.display_name: fns: Monitored workload identity signed in with something other than a key
workload-sign-in-with-secret.query:
let MonitoredIdentities = dynamic({{monitored_identities}});
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| where ServicePrincipalId in~ (MonitoredIdentities)
| where ClientCredentialType !in~ ("clientAssertion", "federatedIdentityCredential", "managedIdentity")
| project TimeGenerated, ServicePrincipalId, ServicePrincipalName, ClientCredentialType, ResourceDisplayName, CorrelationId
